status: Development acceptance criteria; not measured difficulty or proof of admission

shared.design: Create an information gap that useful interaction resolves; do not reward motion counts as evidence of ability.
shared.public_boundary: Unnumbered object RGB; no simulator object IDs in instructions, notebook, feedback or submitted public action references. Candidate choices and placement slots are action controls, not object identity overlays.
shared.case_review: Compare expected behavior with recorded observations, actions, transitions and state. Separate environment design, prompt, harness memory, policy and infrastructure failures. Preserve failed cases.
shared.difficulty: Calibrate levels with repeated matched policy runs; a feasible privileged witness is insufficient.
shared.promotion: Fresh reset and verified execution, public-reference replay, explicit shortcut controls, no identifier overlays, and a documented expectation review. A generated recipe alone cannot replace a demo.

missing_object.ability: Actively survey object-location pairs, commit memory, revisit and identify an actual absence.
expected: Explore beyond the initial view before MEMORIZE
Retain cumulative object and supporting-receptacle evidence
Revisit after the change and submit both object and original receptacle
missing_object.necessary_setting: Preselect an exposed target outside the initial view, with a discoverable observation and support reference. For travel cases, stationary camera rotations must remain insufficient.
shortcut_controls: Initial-view-only inspection cannot observe the target
Immediate commit fails the pre-change evidence requirement
review_risks: Pitch oscillation without new evidence
Memory overwritten by intent text
Correct object but wrong support
Whole-room survey budget lacks a bounded observable scope
missing_object.implementation: active_scan_v1 adds hidden start, explicit commitment, clocks, frozen notebook and strict evidence-aware reward. Translation necessity and full survey feasibility still require native admission.

moved_object.ability: Discriminate object relocation from camera movement and bind old/new locations.
expected: Survey before commitment
Search beyond the original support after relocation
Report object and both receptacles with observed references
moved_object.necessary_setting: Discoverable original and relocated views, spatially distinct receptacles, and no one-image before/after shortcut.
shortcut_controls: Original image alone cannot identify the new support
Immediate commit lacks original object/support evidence
review_risks: Repeated search at the original position
Unseen new receptacle
Camera reset confused with object movement
moved_object.implementation: Shares active_scan_v1; relocation preflight already checks a reachable target view. New cases and observation-limited search budgets need validation.

shape_identification.ability: Select a viewpoint that resolves a specific shape ambiguity.
expected: Move to expose distinguishing geometry
Compare evidence with candidate views
Submit the supported candidate
shape_identification.necessary_setting: At least two candidate geometries produce identical initial target pixels under the actual camera/renderer, and an available camera sequence distinguishes them.
shortcut_controls: Compare actual initial rendered target pixels, not only orthographic silhouettes
Keep reference candidate panel constant across the ambiguity pair
review_risks: Yaw oscillation pointing away from the target
Candidate already recognizable initially
Random camera motion credited as active perception
shape_identification.implementation: New required-ambiguity generation constructs hidden-layer counterfactual pairs, checks actual initial pixels and a bounded revealing camera translation, and rejects failures. Full-resolution new-case admission and VLM behavior remain pending.

pose_alignment.ability: Use object transformations to reach a target orientation while distinguishing them from camera changes.
expected: Identify the pose mismatch
Execute useful object rotations
Submit a symmetry-correct alignment
pose_alignment.necessary_setting: Nonzero initial symmetry-aware error and an executable rotation sequence. Camera motion is optional unless a separate ambiguity condition proves it necessary.
shortcut_controls: Camera-only trajectories cannot fix physical pose
review_risks: Rotating camera instead of object
Initially solved case
Symmetry makes an apparent mismatch irrelevant
pose_alignment.implementation: Existing shortest_alignment and symmetry evaluator support mechanical checks; fresh cases and model traces are required.

memory_maze.ability: Explore landmark locations and use retained information for ordered physical revisits.
expected: Inspect the relevant accessible landmarks before MEMORIZE
Preserve spatial notes
Revisit, MARK in order, and finish near the final landmark
memory_maze.necessary_setting: Nontrivial routes and multiple views; explicit survey commitment. A full exploration-to-recall recording is required.
shortcut_controls: Compare retained/cleared memory under matched observations and budget before claiming memory benefit
review_risks: Automatic phase change bypasses exploration
Reference clip begins in recall
Goal names disclose a route that makes memory unnecessary
memory_maze.implementation: Native ordered visits exist. New protocol must disable automatic commitment; a measured memory advantage remains unestablished.

dependency_doors.ability: Plan physical access, retrieval, transport and restoration under one-hand constraints.
expected: Find and open the source
Pick up and deliver in order
Restore closure and finish empty-handed
dependency_doors.necessary_setting: Closed source blocks pickup; accessible object/destination descriptions uniquely identify visual entities without IDs.
review_risks: Ambiguous repeated cabinet or countertop types
No useful error feedback
Reference solver uses hidden identities directly
dependency_doors.implementation: Native prerequisite preflight exists; public-description admission and fresh visual-reference replay remain required.

relational_rearrangement.ability: Translate a world-frame relation into a physical placement while preserving protected objects.
expected: Identify target and anchor
Pick up and inspect feasible placement
Place to satisfy every relation and finish empty-handed
relational_rearrangement.necessary_setting: Initially false goal, visible world-frame cue, unique target/anchor descriptions, and both valid and invalid placement alternatives.
review_risks: Screen left/right confused with world directions
Ambiguous target/anchor
Slot labels mistaken for object IDs
relational_rearrangement.implementation: Native relation/negative-slot fixtures exist; fresh unnumbered runs and model behavior inspection remain required.

dynamic_replanning.ability: Detect a changed navigation constraint and revise a previously feasible route.
expected: Reach checkpoint
Observe the obstruction or action failure
Use an executable alternate route and mark the goal
dynamic_replanning.necessary_setting: The original route must be physically blocked after the event, while a feasible alternative remains.
shortcut_controls: Replay of original route encounters the verified obstruction
Goal remains reachable via an alternative
review_risks: Oracle detour presented as policy adaptation
Agent never follows the previously feasible route
Blocked-motion loops without diagnostic feedback
dynamic_replanning.implementation: Existing native generation validates collision and a longer detour. Fresh VLM traces must establish actual replanning behavior.
